reasons: The rule is a 'missing'-kind insurance rule and the cited miscellaneous paragraphs (14.9–14.10) contain no coverage obligation; the rationale confirms the only 'insurance' hit elsewhere is the net-revenue definition, so no usable clause exists and the 'missing' classification is correct.

Direction is correct for our side: we represent Corio (the licensee/customer) and the inserted obligation runs against Commerce One, the software/hosting vendor whose consultants and MarketSite.net Service touch Corio and Customer data; nothing in the edit burdens our party.

The redline is a clean, minimal insertion of a new Section 14.10 tracking the model language (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where data is processed, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) with a correct renumber of Complete Understanding to 14.11 and no other text disturbed (changed-character ratio 0.069 on p0133 is purely the renumber).
The comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states what changed and why, cites the preferred limits and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback, and does not overstate the record.
